description: This source file defines a React hook and a utility function for progressive batch processing within a React application. It facilitates applying work in batches asynchronously, yielding control to keep the UI responsive, using requestIdleCallback or a fallback with setTimeout. It includes a React hook 'useProgressiveExpand' to manage the processing state, progress, and cancellation.

methods.name: createProgressiveExpandController({ items, applyBatch, batchSize, timeSliceMs = 10, onProgress, onDone, onCancel, })
methods.description: Creates a controller that manages batch-wise processing of items asynchronously, using requestIdleCallback or setTimeout, with progress and cancel callbacks.

methods.name: useProgressiveExpand({ applyBatch, batchSize, timeSliceMs, onDone, onCancel, autoCancelOnUnmount = true, } = {})
methods.description: A React hook that wraps the progressive expand controller, managing UI state such as running status, progress, counts, and providing methods to start processing from items or cancel ongoing processing.
